svg.title: Version history
svg.desc: Callout Studio's Version history window: saved setups from today and yesterday along a timeline, such as Changes saved, Before an import and Before Reset everything, each with a compare button, a delete button and Restore.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Google Sans Flex", Roboto, "Inter Variable", Inter, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Google Sans Flex", Roboto, "Inter Variable", Inter, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", sans-serif

g.text: Callout Studio saves versions of your setup automatically.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Google Sans Flex", Roboto, "Inter Variable", Inter, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", sans-serif

g.text: Older ones are cleaned up over time.

g.text: Restoring a version replaces your current setup on every synced device.
